body:
First of all good morning or good afternoon, I now come to ask my desban, I know Avicus for 4 months, and me like one of the best servers I am speaking of, and I would ask my desban ..
I first of all say that I have been banned for use KillAura and Anti Knockback, those days I was with much lag Internet could not solve the problem I had with the internet and decided to use a program that improved my internet, I miss that I did not know program that brings consequences: 1) They stood me all players, and could not play, 2) I had my team and I Criticals impossible to play scrimmages with them for the lag. 3) I did not realize it was a program was a hack.
After I downloaded the program I started to see that this was going me in TDM, some users reported me KillAura and Anti Knockback, after play 15 minutes came the SrModerador "SirCyanide" I ban me, after that I did not know that do, I had been banned from one of the best servers for me,  25 days that have banned me, and I already want to return to play Avicus ..


Moderators, Directors or any member of staff please see my post about me desban ..
I hope to play Avicus.
Thank you very much for reading this post, any questions you have agregenme Skype: mirkoo825

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Hello,

While I appreciate your honesty, I would like to state that you have not served enough time to be appealed from your hacking ban. We recommend waiting longer to appeal it, possibly 4 months from now. We're very selective on letting cheaters back onto the server, unfortunately.

Your appeal has been denied.

Regards,
Kavinsky.
